Rae (Product): tiny follow-up from the all-hands Q&A  folks are asking for a TL;DR timeline + owners for: Console batching controls, API billing tiers, and Optimize recommendations. can we lock a short public sentence and owners today?

Jun (Eng): TL;DR from engineering: Console batching - internal canary 2024-06-26, partner beta 2024-07-09, public rollout late July (cert + ops). API billing tiers - beta end of July, GA mid-August. Optimize suggestions (read-only) - 2024-06-30; write-mode later.

Sam (Sales): Sales needs: (1) migration playbook, (2) a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb, (3) rollback steps. partners want clarity on notice windows.

Vera (Marketing): i'll draft the one-paragraph blurb. proposed line: "Late-June internal canary; early-July partner beta; late-July public rollout (subject to certification & SLA signoff)." does that work as the single public sentence?

Priya (Legal): legal note: for billing tiers we'll need contract addenda and pricing guardrails. send proposed terms by July 1 and legal will return redlines by July 10. also confirm data-handling language for Optimize.

Jun (Eng): opt-out and rollback: Console will ship a tenant-level toggle + per-route override. sample admin API: 

```
PUT /admin/v1/tenant/features
{ "smart_batching": false }
```

This is admin-only and will be in the migration playbook. telemetry: batching_ratio, p50_token_latency, p95_token_latency.

Rae (Product): owners & tiny action list: (A) publish one-line timeline + footnotes (owner: Rae) by EOD, (B) migration playbook + rollback steps (owner: Sam) draft by July 3, (C) legal terms for tiers (owner: Priya) by July 10, (D) docs + opt-out API (owner: Jun) by June 25.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime v1.9.3 -> us-west cluster on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z (4 nodes).

Jun (Eng): dev caveat: Optimize write-mode may be gated by partner opt-in and extra eval hooks. we'll publish read-only first to reduce risk.

Rae (Product): perfect. i'll post the one-line timeline in #all-hands and #customer-comm, pin it, and tag owners. reconvene in #product-next-week to confirm final comms. :spiral_calendar_pad:
